BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-CodexBridge
BundleInfo.Author: ChimeraXbridge contributors
BundleInfo.Description: Adds a ChimeraX-integrated AI workspace for querying local AI CLIs such as Codex, Claude, and Gemini, or the OpenAI Responses API tool-calling backend, with open-model, selection, view, and structure reference context. Provides the commands "ai", "codex ask", "codex backend", "codex model", "codex routing", "codex context", "codex selftest", "codex tool", and "codex seqbar", plus a live Qt workspace with quick actions and interactive suggestions.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Command :: ai :: General :: Run AI-planned ChimeraX commands from natural language
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex ask :: General :: Query the selected AI backend with ChimeraX session context
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex backend :: General :: Show or switch the current AI backend
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex model :: General :: Show or override the current AI model
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex effort :: General :: Show or override the current AI reasoning effort
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex auto :: General :: Enable or disable natural-language fallback in the ChimeraX command line
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex context :: General :: Show the ChimeraX context sent to Codex
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex selftest :: General :: Run an in-app self-test for Codex Bridge routing, parser hints, and backend availability
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex routing :: General :: Show or switch natural-language routing between local rules and backend AI
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex tool :: General :: Open the AI Assistant tool
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex actions :: General :: Open the PyMOL-style action pad
ChimeraX :: Command :: codex seqbar :: General :: Open the PyMOL-style top sequence bar
